text:
maya (marketing): Hey team — we need a small set of hero diagrams and one benchmark sparkline for the 4/12 webinar + social promos. Goal: 1 hero explainer diagram, 1 simplified architecture sketch, and 1 compact sparkline showing latency vs cost trend for the benchmark. Deadline: Friday EOD.

sam (design): @maya ok — can you confirm sizes? webinar hero = 1200x675, social card = 1080x1080, deck version = 1920x1080?

maya (marketing): yes those sizes work. Also need a tiny thumbnail 420x280 for the blog. Keep copy minimal — just headline and small subcopy.

liam (growth): For the sparkline, prefer 3 variants: absolute tokens/sec, cost-per-1k-tokens, and normalized latency. We'll A/B test which resonates. Can we make a micro-legend for each?

sam (design): Got it. Quick Q: should the architecture sketch show Dedicated + Private + Hosted routing paths? Or keep it abstract?

maya (marketing): Keep it high-level: user -> routing policy -> model variants (hosted/dedicated/private). Emphasize failover arrows and caching box. No infra-level details.

olivia (brand): Brand checks: use Redwood palette v2 (primary teal + charcoal), rounded corners, and our new icon set for GPUs. Avoid using gradients on the sparkline — keep flat colors. Also add 90% opacity watermark of the small logo on the deck hero.

sam (design): Copying brand notes. Will follow token color tokens: #00A89C (teal), #1E293B (charcoal), accent #FFB03B. Any copy for the hero headline?

maya (marketing): Headline options (short):
- "Inference that scales — predictable cost, consistent latency"
- "Ship LLM features with predictable economics"
Pick the shorter one for social. Deck can use the longer.

sam (design): Plan: produce initial comps by Wed morning (3 variants each), then iterate after feedback. Deliverables:
```
- hero_webinar_1920x1080_v1.png
- hero_social_1080x1080_v1.png
- hero_blogthumb_420x280_v1.png
- arch_sketch_1920x1080_v1.svg
- sparkline_pack_3variants_v1.svg
```
I'll upload Figma files and export PNGs.

figma-bot: Figma file created — https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/Redwood-Webinar-Hero (permissions: team-edit)

liam (growth): Nice. Can you include micro-CTAs on social variants like "Register" vs "Watch On-Demand"? We'll test both.

maya (marketing): Yes, include both CTAs as layer options, but deliver base images without CTAs too.

olivia (brand): Also add a short brand note in the Figma file: allowed logo lockups, min clearspace, and color hexes. I can review final exports Thurs afternoon.

sam (design): Cool — tagging tasks: @olivia for brand review, @liam for CTA variants. Will add a comments frame in Figma for copy and CTA placements.

maya (marketing): Thanks — FYI production checklist: we need 2 compressed PNG sizes for web (high/low) and one optimized SVG for emails.

sam (design): noted. Any accessibility checks? Contrast and alt text placeholders?

olivia (brand): Ensure text contrast >= 4.5:1 for small copy. Provide suggested alt text in the export notes.

maya (marketing): Great — ping me in this thread when first drafts are up.

sam (design): Will do. First drafts Wed 09:00 PST.

liam (growth): Thanks — will prepare split-test matrix and landing page variants once we have final assets.

maya (marketing): Awesome, appreciate it :rocket:
